set.body:
Owner directive (2026-09-01, single-developer mode): the first acquisition court's F1 rung (ledger §6 item 2): one separately admitted 20–40 s Big Buck Bunny excerpt tests real container and codec behaviour. Follows bd-01M1FDNN3T4SKZ5ZJN1XGXYNY7 and bd-01M1FEN59CZCCR0SR3B6MZ1KYB under the same ledger §6.1 authorization.

What lands
- Admission of F1 v1: media/src/test/resources/f1/f1-v1.manifest.json records the official source (Blender Foundation, CC BY 3.0, BigBuckBunny_320x180.mp4.zip: archive sha256 109e3ede…, inner file sha256 f78f3960…), the attribution, and the derivation (media/tools/derive_f1.sh: packet copy of 30 s from the keyframe at 300.000 s, both streams, no re-encode, bit-exact; excerpt sha256 efcdc104…, 3,640,647 bytes). Two consecutive derivations were byte-identical. The excerpt bytes are external-local-only (tmp/f1/f1-v1.mp4); no film bytes are committed.
- Recorded runs for CI replay: ffprobe envelope + verbatim stdout (720 h264 packets on 1/12288 at 512 ticks; 1407 aac packets on 1/48000 starting at PTS -512 under the edit list), frames envelope (720 bgr24 frames of 320x180, sha256 e1fcc243…, 124 MB not committed), detector request/outcome/envelope (ContentDetector threshold 27.0, min scene length 15: eight cuts at ordinals 125, 199, 300, 346, 413, 461, 532, 569; two worker runs byte-identical).
- Courts (F1ExcerptSuite, 6): exact replay of the probe (constant 512-tick spacing, extent [0, 368640), PTS equals DTS); lawful negative first audio PTS with contiguous tiling; one decoded frame per packet and eight draft proposals whose instants come from the packet index; recorded source, licence, attribution and a new identity distinct from archive and inner file; F0 and F1 are distinct derivations and an F0 request cannot be answered by F1 output; live court (ffprobe, ffmpeg, worker) when the excerpt and tools are present, never downloading.

What this does not establish
- Nothing about where the shots, scenes, or events of the film are: no annotation or gold is admitted with F1, and the eight proposals are detector proposals about visual discontinuity under a declared recipe.
- Patent posture and deployment jurisdiction for H.264 decoding remain HoldUnknown (ledger §4); decoding used the local Homebrew build recorded in §6.2.
- The muxer's timebase rescale (1/24 to 1/12288) and the AAC priming packet are facts of the excerpt container, recorded and not repaired.
set.title: First acquisition court, F1: Big Buck Bunny excerpt admitted, recorded probe, decode, and detector run
